candidates.name: Practice Guide 41 supplement 2: estate plan approval
verified_facts: Estate plan approval is designed to simplify official copies, searches and subsequent registrations while a site is active.
Approved plot numbers can be referenced in later applications.
semantic_limits: Administrative estate-plan approval does not certify parcel terrain height, vertical datum, survey instrument or measurement uncertainty.

candidates.name: Practice Guide 41 supplement 3: approval of draft transfers and leases
verified_facts: HM Land Registry provides a service to approve standard draft transfers and leases for developing estates.
The service is intended to work with estate boundary and estate plan approval processes.
semantic_limits: Approval of legal-document form or plot references is not independent evidence of exact geometry or elevation accuracy.
